topNews.text: Chihuahua Won’t Stop Pawing at Her Until Owner Finds the Breast Cancer She Smelled
topNews.excerpt: A dog owner says her pooch saved her life, by repeatedly pawing at her armpit, which eventually alerted her to breast cancer. The 61-year-old says her chihuahua Flag started the odd behavior years ago, constantly hitting the underside of her arm with his paw. topNews.text: ‘Game-Changing’ Saliva Test Can Diagnose Endometriosis in Days Rather Than Years
topNews.excerpt: Two new rapid tests, EndoSure and Endotest, can drastically reduce the wait time for a proper diagnosis of endometriosis—from an average nine-year wait to just days.
